title: Amazon Connect: a cloud contact center

kcs.statement: Amazon Connect is a cloud contact center service for setting up customer-service phone and chat channels in minutes, paid per use with no telephony hardware.

problem_ideas: A retailer needs a customer-service phone line with 50 agents working from home next week: which service?
Spot the distractor: 'Use SES to route inbound customer calls.'
A contact centre wants call transcripts and sentiment: which AI services pair with Connect?
Seasonal call volume triples in December: explain why pay-per-use suits it.
Match three business needs (email campaigns, phone support, internal chat) to services, ruling out Connect where wrong.
A company wants an IVR menu with self-service balance checks: which service hosts the flow?
